eval_rubric:
1. None of the following appear anywhere in the deck: director/officer compensation figures (base salary, cash incentives, equity awards), the 92% Say-on-Pay approval figure, board committee composition (Audit, People and Compensation, Nominating) or director names/bios (e.g. Art Levinson, Tim Cook, Wanda Austin), the 70% institutional-shares-engaged figure, or any of the five annual-meeting voting proposals (director election, auditor ratification, say-on-pay vote, director stock plan amendment, China Entanglement Audit) and their FOR/AGAINST recommendations.
2. The deck leads with business performance, not governance: fiscal 2025 headline figures appear grounded exactly as stated -- $416.2 billion all-time revenue record, 46.9% gross margin (+70 bps YoY), $7.46 diluted EPS, over $110 billion returned to shareholders -- with no rounding to figures like '~$416B' or invented precision.
3. Services growth is stated as given: 14% YoY growth surpassing $100 billion in revenue for the first time, with all-time revenue records in the majority of tracked markets including named emerging markets (India, Latin America, Middle East) -- no invented per-region revenue figures.
4. The deck gives a sense of the new product lineup (per the request), sticking to what's named in the filing (iPhone 17 lineup, Apple Watch Series 11 and Ultra 3, AirPods Pro 3, M5 chip, Apple Intelligence features including Visual Intelligence and Live Translation, Liquid Glass design update) without adding capabilities, dates, or figures not in the source.
5. No fabricated or inferred figures anywhere (e.g. no invented China or geographic-segment revenue breakdown, since the filing does not disclose one at this level of detail).
